_meta.description: Example campus room information database - directions and details
_meta.notes: Coordinates left blank for future mapping. Directions compiled from various sources.

Science Hall.general_directions: From the main gate, walk straight to the central quad. Science Hall is the large building on the north side.

Library.general_directions: Enter through the main gate and follow the path to the central quad; the Library faces the quad.

Student Center.description: Student organizations, food court, and event space.
Student Center.general_directions: From the central quad, take the east path; the Student Center is the building with the large mural.

SCI 101.directions: Ground floor of Science Hall, first room on the left.

LIB 305.directions: Third floor of the Library, quiet study wing.

tips: Room numbers often encode the floor: first digit = floor number (e.g., 305 = 3rd floor, 101 = 1st floor)
B prefix usually means Basement (e.g., SCI B05 = Science Hall Basement Room 05)
When lost, ask campus staff or students - you only need to do it once!
